items.title: What sparked the stock market’s $2.5 trillion sell-off?
items.brief: A stunning $2.5 trillion was wiped off the value of the tech-heavy Nasdaq on Thursday as investors rushed to dump tech stocks, rattled by fears that Democrats’ midterm victories could slow the AI buildout.

items.title: Kenyan cult leader sentenced to 200 years in prison over the deaths of 190 children
items.brief: A Kenyan cult leader has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murder of 191 people, all but one of them children, in a campaign of abuse and forced fasting.
